title: Lessons from Picou, Bechet and Ory; Jimbo; California
summary: Barnes took lessons from Picou with Sidney Bechet, discusses who left New Orleans and prospered, Ory and Jimbo, and his visit to California.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Who did you have lessons from?
Oh, Piku.
Piku for one, huh?

I didn't just went over there, nothing else felt like. Took a little lesson, me and Piku. Another boy that died, uh, Hanukkah, Armageddon, uh, Sidney Veen. That's a classic where he died, too. I mean, Sidney, we used to take lessons from Piku, same time.
What kind of a clarinet player was Piku in those days? Piku was a good clarinet player.
Did he ever play any jazz?

Well, those men wasn't much on jazz. Louis was a man on jazz. We got Louis. They said Piku, Manana, and all them, you know, them guys that was on the dots. Brockie and all that folks. They said Piku, Manana, and all them. How about Teal? Teal? Oh, that was a good man. He was on the dots and he was jazz. He was on the dots and he was on jazz. How about Teal? How about Teal? How about Teal? How about Teal? How about Teal? How about Teal? How about Teal? How about Teal? How about Teal? How about Teal?
How about Teal? Did he ever play any jazz, Nicholas?
Nicholas? He wasn't much here. He grew that too left from here, like Lewis. I see Lewis and them left from here, they grew Jimbo and all that kind of man.
You said Lewis wasn't a great trumpet player down here?
Who?
Lewis Armstrong.
Yes, Lewis was good down here.
But he growed more after he got up there?

Oh, after he went up there he just went on to town. Yeah, same thing with Bichet. When Bichet got here and went up there he went to town. When Bichet was here, he stood raggedy all his days. He'd come here with a suit full of clothes and in a little time he was raggedy. This was his bad luck place for him. He went on up the road, he done good the many they got. Kept himself naughty. Down here just like a man hanging up sleeping in some junk shop. Now when Sidney left here and Jimbo left, I was supposed to leave him Jimbo's place.
With what band?

Well, I don't know what band he was supposed to go with, but anyhow he left him once and he went with O'erah in there. You understand? And he stood a while and I believe he went with some other band from up there and after that I think he built his own band like O'erah did. Yeah, I'm sure of that. I'm not so positive because it was told to me then.
Yeah, well he made records and everything. Yeah.
Jimmy Newell.
Jimmy Newell.

Well, yeah, when they called the name of Jimmy Newell I couldn't get that together. I don't know where he come from. They called him Jimbo here. That's by calling that nickname, you understand? That's true at all. You take all those men, I know all those boys. Drew Robson, the triumphant player went away from here. Joe Oliver. I'm sure I know him. I'm just awake with all those men. Wake with them when they reckoned when they didn't meet him, it would come there. That's all you representing. Theo sent me, Luis sent me, Joy sent me. All right, you ain't a good man. That was it. Yeah, I was supposed to die away from here. I was supposed to come here. I was supposed to leave from here when the first bunch of men came out. I just didn't believe in going nowhere. I just didn't believe in. Since I'm here I could have went away. I couldn't go away from here and stay three months to save my life. I went to California by one of my daughters up there and was to go there for two months. That second month when that first month was out, whew. I was sick, I had to get home.
Did you sit in with Ori out there? Uh-uh. You never did play with him out there in California?

No, I never heard him out there. When I went there, let's see, I believe he had a boy in Crowley from Texas and a trumpet from somewhere else he had on it. When I went in this music hall, we talked a long time. That was a room about big as this. All them boys, pictures on the wall, piano there, drum, bass, callers. Band system, the crown of the airbag. I went out to different places to look at them little funny bands, bop bands.
They have a lot of funny bands out there?
When I went out there I didn't hear but one place that I went. I didn't fancy too much because it was all right, nice and clean. It seemed to be in order, but I just didn't fancy that much.
